messages:
Ken: Heads-up: rolling out release v3.14.2 to prod in the 12:00 PT change window. Commit abcdef123. Canary on 3 hosts. @maria @jess please confirm backout hooks & owner handoffs.

deploy-bot: Canary started in us-west-2 — 3/3 healthy. Canary token cb-782. Use `deploy show abcdef123` for details.

Jess: On canary verification — smoke tests green, basic QA done. Watching logs for 10m.

Maria: Runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/deploy-backout. TL;DR: 1) scale down new release group 2) pin previous tag 3) trigger kill-switch if 5xx rate spike.

Ken: Adding emergency cmds for quick copy: ```./ops/rollback --tag v3.14.1 --force``` and `kubectl set image deployment/web server=redwood/web:v3.14.1` — keep these handy.

Ryan: Note — model-serving image bigger this time, expect slower cold starts. If p95 > 200ms or error >0.8% for 3m, abort+pin older image. I'm oncall.

Sara: Alerting is set: page on 5xx >0.8% sustained 3m. I also updated the runbook with a postmortem checklist and ownership table.

Maria: Also: Dedicated customers have pin locks. Unpin requires CS ticket — ping @cs-leads before touching org pins.

Ken: Agree. If we backout we should notify #status and #customer-impact before unpin. Avoid surprise alerts.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: errors 0.12% | p95 170ms. Proceeding to 25% ramp in 2m. Metrics: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123

Jess: go for ramp, eyes on logs.

Ken: Update: at ~25% ramp we saw spike to 1.2% errors and increased tail latency. Initiating backout per runbook now. Steps: pin v3.14.1, scale down canary, run rollback commands.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by ken — job rb-202511. Expected finish ~2m. Notifying #status.

Ryan: Rollback complete, health restored. Error rate back to baseline. Filed postmortem INF-9876: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9876. Good coordination — will follow up on root cause and runbook tweaks. :thumbsup:
